name: Community contacts
description: One address book for the whole community, linked from the work in every initiative.
long_description:
An initiative's contacts belong to that initiative. Community contacts are the venues, suppliers and people every initiative works with, kept once instead of copied into each.

- Every member can look them up; each contact's sharing can narrow that
- Link a contact from tasks, events and files in any initiative
- Each contact's page gathers that work: open tasks, upcoming events and files
- Everything an initiative's contacts do, for the whole community: organizations and their people, one-tap calls and emails, and spreadsheet import and export
